brand.subtitle: Urban Supply Action
home.eyebrow: Bringing steady goodwill to those who need it most
home.h1: Aquaflow turns every supply run into a clear, sustainable, and transparent public record.
home.hero-text: Here you'll find upcoming plans, field records, and contact info — all maintained as Markdown documents, with one folder per session for text, photos, and route data.
home.status.maintenance-text: One folder per session, containing index.md and images/.
home.card1.title: What We Do
home.card1.text: We provide low-intervention, lightweight water and supply support to urban construction workers, outdoor laborers, and field workers.
home.card2.title: How to Read Plans
home.card2.text: The Plans page lists upcoming supply runs, with timing, starting point, target area, and what we're bringing.
home.card3.title: How to Read Records
home.card3.text: The Records page archives route observations, execution feedback, and photos to help each run improve over time.
philosophy.h2: Less slogans. More supply runs that actually happen.
philosophy.card1.title: Follow the Field Rhythm
philosophy.card1.text: We avoid disrupting people's work. No extra attention, no spectacle — just getting supplies to where they're truly needed.
philosophy.card2.title: Prioritize Sustainability
philosophy.card2.text: We value lightweight, stable, repeatable actions over one-time grand gestures.
philosophy.card3.title: Document Everything
philosophy.card3.text: Every run leaves clear plans and records so future volunteers know what happened and how to do it better.
plan.h2: Each plan outlines volunteer arrangements, activity pacing, and location details, with map support for meeting points.
record.h2: Records are archived per session, combining written summaries and photo assets in a single folder.
volunteers.h2: Everyone who shows up is what this supply action truly looks like.
trails.h2: Discover China's most beautiful hiking trails — practical English guides for international travelers.
